sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position and will be heavy favorites against Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once all season. This is a chance for the leaders to bounce back immediately.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture that could have title-race implications; Stafford are just two points behind Sandbach. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in an intriguing mid-table clash between two in-form sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table, face Wednesfield Community at home, a local derby with playoff implications. Bilston Town (6th) host Foley Meir (13th) in a match-up between contrasting form lines. Barnton welcome Shawbury United in a meeting of mid-table sides, while New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a basement-zone encounter. Crewe host Allscott Heath in another lower-division fixture. The week's final match sees Brereton Social (3rd from bottom) visit Wednesfield Community on Wednesday evening in a rearranged midweek fixture. Cheadle Heath Nomads, struggling near the foot of the table, travel to Telford Town, another side fighting relegation fears. Widnes Town, pointless at the foot of the league, travel to Brereton Social on Saturday, a fixture between the division's two lowest-positioned teams.
